system.description:
This spell song is both a history lesson and a wondrous show of lights and images. As the ages are recited, the Elf intermingles phrases of memory and power, and scenes of aeons past float before the listeners.

Obstacle: See description. Events of the current age, Ob 1; of the Third Age, Ob 2; of the Second Age, Ob 3; First Age, Ob 4; of the Years of the Sun, Ob 5; of the Creation and before time, Ob 6.

Actions: Obstacle x 100.

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 148
